title: OB-1 (Digitone machine)
author: elektrob-1-dn contributors
description: OB-1, the Oberheim OB-1's oscillator section (two VCOs with saw/pulse/sub, sync, cross mod, noise and mixer) as a Digitone mk1 / Keys machine. The Digitakt machine's fifteen controls over two pages: SYN2 A-H FRQ1/FIN1/TYP1/WAV1/FRQ2/FIN2/TYP2/WAV2, SYN1 A-H FND1/OCT1/XMOD/blank/FND2/OCT2/SYNC/NOIS, all on borrowed stock SYN ranges (no custom params), through the Digitone filter/mixer/AMP. A thin adapter over the shared dsp/ engine, ported from the Digitakt machine. Needs the machines mod and core-dn1.
